name: Berries and Farm Helpers
description: A few small mods make growing food easier.

pages.title: Berries and Farm Helpers
pages.text:
A few small mods make growing food easier. **Berry Good** improves berries. **Better Farming Right Click** saves you replanting time. Seasons decide when crops grow.

Fruit trees, jams and pies come from the [#](2E5AAC)[Delight add-ons](entry://food/farmers_delight_addons)[#]().

pages.title: Berry Good
pages.text: Makes sweet berries less annoying to eat and adds berry foods: baskets, pips, meatballs, glowgurt and more. Glow berries get the same treatment.

**Better Farming Right Click** lets you right-click a mature crop to harvest and replant it in one go. Toggle it from its in-game options; there is also a no-cooldown setting for tools and seeds.

Rice, tomatoes and onions come from [#](2E5AAC)[Farmer's Delight](entry://food/farmers_delight)[#]().

Seasons matter for crops. Serene Seasons ties growth to the calendar, so many crops struggle out of season; plan farms around it. Seasonal Integration extends this to other mods.

See [#](2E5AAC)[Seasons](entry://survival/seasons)[#](). Create farms: [#](2E5AAC)[Integrated Farming](entry://food/integrated_farming)[#]().
